items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf.
items.why: Schefter confirmed active; Rams optimistic Saturday, no setbacks. ETR had GTD/optimism; Berry confirmed active.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1/2; Adams already OUT long-term.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected in depleted WR room.

items.text: Breece Hall INACTIVE; Jets RBs without him.
items.why: Schefter inactives list; Rapoport earlier said unlikely, not full participant. ETR GTD/pessimism.
items.implication: Braelon Allen lead role again; Hall targets Week 8 return.
items.opportunity: Allen RB1 upside vs Dolphins; handcuff confirmed.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 7.
items.why: ETR weekend summary of reports; Rapoport noted he was close but out this week, expected next.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley or backup starts; Ravens pass game limited, Henry/Likely/Andrews usage shifts possible.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming or Ravens skill upside if run-heavy.

items.text: Jonah Coleman led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34% in first game back; Dobbins only 21% snaps. Roster in 100% leagues.
items.why: Berry pre-season call confirmed post-game; snap/rush/route shares.
items.implication: Coleman the Broncos RB to own; Dobbins downgraded.
items.opportunity: Coleman lead back role expansion; waiver priority.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) on OT slide/run but not certain severity; Giants have bye.
items.why: Levitan: think actually hurt. Reports: felt something on 42-yd OT run, slid; bye helps recovery.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 9; Tracy also hamstring. Possible limited or miss.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup upside if out; bye week rest.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if serious while correctly not scoring.
items.why: Levitan on ETR watch list; Campbell said should be good, checked precautionary. Free Press: twisted but fine.
items.implication: No drop in ROS ranking; continue RB1.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT.
items.why: ETR summary; Eagles injury report confirmed.
items.implication: AJ Brown and Goedert elevated targets/routes; Hurts checkdowns.
items.opportunity: Brown WR1 ceiling spike; Goedert TE1.

items.why: ETR weekend reports; returned to practice.
items.implication: Start if active; monitor snaps vs Cowboys MNF.
items.opportunity: Lead back role if cleared; Gainwell handcuff if limited.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play.
items.why: ETR and Schefter activations list; returned from layoff.
items.implication: Lead RB role for Packers; monitor rust/snaps.
items.opportunity: Volume RB2/flex; handcuffs drop in value.

items.text: Seahawks opening 21-day practice window for Jadarian Price (chest); Charbonnet plan unchanged, short of playing vs Bears.
items.why: Rapoport/Macdonald; Schefter echoed help on way. Levitan noted possible Taylor trade suitors including SEA, Price status.
items.implication: Depth add; may not immediately leap Charbonnet/Wilson.
items.opportunity: Stash in deep leagues; SEA RB committee watch + possible JT trade.

items.text: Nico Collins led Texans with 24 routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in return, Noel left early turf toe.
items.why: Levitan post-game routes; Dell limited first game since 2024.
items.implication: Nico clear WR1; Dell slow ramp.
items.opportunity: Nico target share secure; Dell handcuff/watch.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury not significant, day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 8; Mason already back.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33/36 routes (lead) second game without Rashee Rice; never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games.
items.why: Levitan charted routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks; ceiling note on historical production.
items.implication: Volume there but efficiency/ceiling capped without Rice; WR3/flex with risk.
items.opportunity: Route share spike while Rice out (hamstring).
items.conflict: High opportunity but low historical ceiling.

items.text: Garrett Wilson 29 routes, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 52 season routes) with AD Mitchell back on 33 Geno dropbacks.
items.why: Levitan routes data; Cooper efficiency note as 30th pick.
items.implication: Wilson still lead but Cooper emerging threat; Wilson WR2 floor.
